cargo-test_label: cargo test (Rust tests and proptest properties)
cargo-test_missing: cargo is not installed or not on the PATH ({detail}). Install the Rust toolchain with rustup (https://www.rust-lang.org/tools/install), put cargo on the PATH, or point JGATES_CARGO to it. JGates never installs a toolchain during a run.
cargo-test_fix: cargo is supplied by you: install Rust with rustup (https://www.rust-lang.org/tools/install), make sure cargo is on the PATH (or set JGATES_CARGO), fetch the crate dependencies once (cargo fetch; the run is offline), then run doctor again.
cargo-test_probe_failed: cargo at {path} did not answer --version. Reinstall the Rust toolchain with rustup.
cargo-test_no_manifest: No Cargo.toml was found in the component, so there is nothing to test.
cargo-test_exit_error: cargo test ended with code {code} without any test result (a compilation error or a crash): {detail}
cargo-test_timeout: cargo test exceeded the limit of {seconds} s and was ended.
cargo-test_cancelled: The run was cancelled; cargo test was stopped and its partial output was kept in the logs.
cargo-test_invalid_output: The cargo test output is not the expected libtest text: {detail}
cargo-test_no_invocation: The plan has no cargo test invocation for the instance {tool}.
cargo-test_reason_no_proptest: The crate does not use proptest: there are no property tests to judge.
cargo-test_limitation_static: Property tests are found by reading the .rs files (proptest! blocks and #[proptest] functions); a property written another way counts as an ordinary test.
cargo-test_limitation_offline: The run is offline: the dependencies of the crate (proptest included) must already be in the cargo home. The tests, build scripts and procedural macros of the project execute.
cargo-test_condition_executes: Executes the project's tests, build scripts and procedural macros; build artifacts go to the run folder.
cargo-test_condition_properties: proptest failure persistence is disabled so that no proptest-regressions file is written into the project.
